name: Companion App
description: LAN API for the Android companion app's Settings and Files tabs — edit box-wide settings (display, theme, network, party, time machine, updates) and browse/download files from your channel folders, from your phone. Pairing-code + session auth, same as the other LAN services. Runs same-process (not isolated) because file browsing needs real filesystem access to wherever your channel folders actually live, which the isolated-plugin sandbox can't grant. Works standalone; independent of Universal Remote.

net.why: the Android companion app's Settings and Files tabs connect to this from the LAN
